relationships.source_scope: Same non-concept aspects; compatible numeric base types and period type; +/-1.
relationships.extra_premises: Verified concept meaning, sign, units, currency, scale, measurement basis, reporting perimeter, revision and relation applicability.
relationships.failure: A mathematically fitting label mapping can combine incompatible measurements.
relationships.disposition: Possible constraint after premises; arithmetic does not establish treatment.

relationships.source_scope: Selected member hierarchy and concept-sensitive aggregation.
relationships.extra_premises: Disjoint/exhaustive selected partition; overlapping alternate hierarchies kept separate; eliminations, unallocated residuals and ratio denominators handled explicitly.
relationships.failure: Double counting or summing share-class EPS and rates.

relationships.source_scope: No aggregation or aggregation to absent dimension; nil-valued typed total excluded.
relationships.extra_premises: Typed value identity/normalisation and an evidenced complete component population; unchanged scope and units.
relationships.failure: Nil dimension, absent dimension and missing fact collapse into one state.
relationships.disposition: Keep all three states distinct; no policy selected.

relationships.source_scope: Opening/closing instant facts of one concept with signed duration movements.
relationships.extra_premises: Exact boundary convention; same entity/perimeter, measurement and revision; complete movements including FX, acquisitions, disposals and reclassifications where applicable.
relationships.failure: Residual is falsely labelled an undisclosed economic event.
relationships.disposition: Conditional accounting relation; transaction identities remain unidentified.

relationships.source_scope: Infer duration from consecutive shorter durations.
relationships.extra_premises: No gaps/overlap; distinguish standalone quarter from year-to-date; same concept/basis and revision; flow is additive over chosen periods.
relationships.failure: Summed cumulative quarters count the same flow repeatedly.

relationships.source_scope: Use dimensional/concept intermediate totals even if not reported.
relationships.extra_premises: Every leaf population complete and compatible; deduplicate shared facts; retain source graph, common variables and inferred status; resolve multiple paths/conflicts without overwriting.
relationships.failure: Local passing sums conceal joint inconsistency or manufactured reported evidence.
relationships.disposition: A derived value stays derived; no unique history follows.

relationships.relationship: Fact sections, missing values and nil
relationships.source_scope: Preparer can associate complete fact sections with relations; nil is unknown; table-level indicator alone insufficient.
relationships.extra_premises: Source-supported membership and completeness assertion, plus explicit unresolved omissions.
relationships.failure: Only cash is available at an earlier instant and is misreported as total current assets.

relationships.source_scope: Intervals, configurable report-level method, generous tie default and most-precise duplicate proposal.
relationships.extra_premises: Identify authoritative adopted rule, endpoint semantics and actual report policy; shared quantities retain common constraints.
relationships.failure: An early proposal overwrites corrected Recommendation or local interval overlap becomes global feasibility.
relationships.disposition: Difference recorded; prior exact duplicate witness reused by reference only.

relationships.source_scope: Default balance-attribute constraint may be explicitly disabled per calculation.
relationships.extra_premises: Actual equation and concept semantics justify signs; collector constraints retained.
relationships.failure: An override is taken as proof of a valid journal or accounting treatment.
relationships.disposition: Attribute exception does not remove accounting obligations.

relationships.source_scope: Reuse or recreate taxonomy relations; no required cross-entity/unit or weighted-member solution.
relationships.extra_premises: Versioned mapping and extension relation provenance; separate consolidation, conversion, weighted-average and event/accounting models.
relationships.failure: Supporting draft description is treated as delivered whole-company reconstruction.
relationships.disposition: Source informs design preparation; no implementation/adoption or manuscript change.

conclusion: Reporting relations need verified company-specific premises before history constraints
